Question
========
What is the average read time for a request to read one sector on a disk using 512 B sectors, 10000 rpm, 4 ms average (head) seek time, 300 MB/s transfer rate and 0.1 ms controller overhead, without any pending request?

Decompose your answer.

Solution
========
Four terms add up:

- Controller overhead: 0.1 ms
- Seek time: 4 ms
- Rotational latency: half a revolution. One revolution is 60/10000 = 6 ms, so 3 ms on average.
- Transfer: 512 B / 300 MB/s = about 0.0017 ms, negligible.

Total is about 0.1 + 4 + 3 + 0.002 = 7.1 ms.
